breakpoints.note: After the harness dispatches `typeIndex == UA_TYPES_DATAVALUE`, project-side decoding enters `DataValue_decodeBinary` for the remaining payload bytes.
After the top-level DataValue encoding mask indicates that a value is present, the decoder materializes the attacker-controlled UA_Variant that later becomes the stale-pointer cleanup target.

Error cleanup frees `p->data` but does not clear the field afterwards. The fix adds `p->data = NULL;` immediately after `UA_Array_delete`, so the later `UA_clear` on the same destination no longer reuses a freed array pointer.

Second cleanup of the same partially copied DataValue re-enters Variant_clear on a stale `p->data` pointer. The very first read of `p->storageType` comes from the first element of an already freed 192-byte UA_DataValue array, triggering the AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free READ 4.
